```{shinylive-python}
    """),

    ui.tags.section(
        {"id": "region-scenario", "role": "region", "aria-labelledby": "heading-scenario", "class": "region-container"},
        ui.tags.h2({"id": "heading-scenario", "class": "region-header"}, "1. Scenario Selection"),

        ui.layout_columns(

        ),

    ),

    # Region 2: Priorities and Weights
    ui.tags.section(
        {"id": "region-priorities", "role": "region", "aria-labelledby": "heading-priorities", "class": "region-container"},
        ui.tags.h2({"id": "heading-priorities", "class": "region-header"}, "2. Priorities & Eligibility Requirements"),
        ui.tags.p("Choose a published starting preset or define custom percentage priorities totaling 100%."),
        ui.layout_columns(
            ui.input_select(
                "preset_select",
                "Preference Preset",
                {
                    "community_balanced": "Community-balanced (28% Acc, 20% Contig, 17% Res, 35% Repl)",
                    "complete_replicon_recovery": "Complete-replicon-recovery (Gate: all replicons ≥95%)",
                    "sequence_accurate_assembly": "Sequence-accurate-assembly (50% Acc, 14% Contig, 12% Res, 24% Repl)",
                    "custom": "Custom Priorities"
                },
                selected="community_balanced"
            ),

            col_widths=(6, 6)

            ui.tags.strong("Scope: "), "13 bacterial reference isolates, 17 QC–trimming combinations (884 observations)"

def server(input, output, session):

    show_all = reactive.Value(False)

    @reactive.Effect
    @reactive.event(input.btn_reveal_all)
    def _toggle_show_all():
        show_all.set(not show_all.get())

    @reactive.Effect
    @reactive.event(input.preset_select)
    def _apply_preset():
        p = input.preset_select()
        if p == "community_balanced":
            ui.update_numeric("w_acc", value=28)
            ui.update_numeric("w_cont", value=20)
            ui.update_numeric("w_res", value=17)
            ui.update_numeric("w_rep", value=35)
            ui.update_checkbox("gate_complete", value=False)
            ui.update_checkbox("gate_zero_hits", value=False)
        elif p == "complete_replicon_recovery":
            ui.update_numeric("w_acc", value=43)
            ui.update_numeric("w_cont", value=31)
            ui.update_numeric("w_res", value=26)
            ui.update_numeric("w_rep", value=0)
            ui.update_checkbox("gate_complete", value=True)
            ui.update_checkbox("gate_zero_hits", value=False)
        elif p == "sequence_accurate_assembly":
            ui.update_numeric("w_acc", value=50)
            ui.update_numeric("w_cont", value=14)
            ui.update_numeric("w_res", value=12)
            ui.update_numeric("w_rep", value=24)
            ui.update_checkbox("gate_complete", value=False)
            ui.update_checkbox("gate_zero_hits", value=False)

    @reactive.Calc
    def load_metrics_data():
        try:
            return pd.read_csv("assets/data/assembly_metrics.csv")
        except Exception:
            return pd.read_csv("assembly_metrics.csv")

    @reactive.Calc
    def weights_valid():
        w1 = input.w_acc() or 0
        w2 = input.w_cont() or 0
        w3 = input.w_res() or 0
        w4 = input.w_rep() or 0
        if w1 < 0 or w2 < 0 or w3 < 0 or w4 < 0:
            return False
        total = w1 + w2 + w3 + w4
        return total == 100 and total > 0

    @output
    @render.ui
    def scenario_validation_msg():
        m = input.model_select()
        d = input.depth_select()
        if not m or not d:
            return ui.HTML("<div class='alert alert-info' role='alert'><strong>Notice:</strong> Please select both a basecalling model and sequencing depth to view recommendations.</div>")
        return ui.HTML(f"<div class='alert alert-success' role='status'>Active Scenario: <strong>{m.upper()}</strong> basecalling at <strong>{d}</strong> depth.</div>")

    @output
    @render.ui
    def preset_description():
        p = input.preset_select()
        descriptions = {
            "community_balanced": "Community-balanced: 28% sequence accuracy, 20% reference contiguity, 17% residual removal, 35% replicon recovery.",
            "complete_replicon_recovery": "Complete-replicon-recovery: Enforces ≥95% coverage on all reference replicons; ranks eligible tools with 43% accuracy, 31% contiguity, 26% residual removal.",
            "sequence_accurate_assembly": "Sequence-accurate-assembly: Prioritizes base-level sequence fidelity with 50% accuracy weight.",
            "custom": "Custom Priorities: Specify your own percentage weights totaling 100% and toggle non-compensatory gates."
        }
        desc = descriptions.get(p, "")
        return ui.tags.div({"class": "alert alert-secondary", "style": "margin-bottom: 0; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.9rem;"}, desc)

    @output
    @render.ui
    def weight_total_indicator():
        w1 = input.w_acc() or 0
        w2 = input.w_cont() or 0
        w3 = input.w_res() or 0
        w4 = input.w_rep() or 0
        total = w1 + w2 + w3 + w4
        diff = total - 100
        if diff == 0:
            return ui.HTML("<div style='color: #16a34a; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 4px;'>✓ Total: <strong>100%</strong></div>")
        elif diff < 0:
            return ui.HTML(f"<div style='color: #dc2626; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 4px;'>⚠ Total: <strong>{total}%</strong> ({abs(diff)}% remaining to allocate) — <em>Ranking paused</em></div>")
        else:
            return ui.HTML(f"<div style='color: #dc2626; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 4px;'>⚠ Total: <strong>{total}%</strong> ({diff}% above 100%) — <em>Ranking paused</em></div>")

    @output
    @render.ui
    def shortlist_status_msg():
        m = input.model_select()
        d = input.depth_select()
        if not m or not d:
            return ui.HTML("<p class='text-muted'>Awaiting scenario selection.</p>")
        if not weights_valid():
            return ui.HTML("<div class='alert alert-warning' role='alert'><strong>Ranking paused:</strong> Allocation must total exactly 100% before recommendations can be evaluated.</div>")
        return None

    @reactive.Calc
    def evaluated_results():
        m = input.model_select()
        d = input.depth_select()
        if not m or not d or not weights_valid():
            return [], []

        df = load_metrics_data()
        subset = df[(df["model"] == m) & (df["depth"] == d)]

        gate_complete = input.gate_complete()
        gate_zero_hits = input.gate_zero_hits()

        w_acc = (input.w_acc() or 0) / 100.0
        w_cont = (input.w_cont() or 0) / 100.0
        w_res = (input.w_res() or 0) / 100.0
        w_rep = (input.w_rep() or 0) / 100.0

        eligible_records = []
        excluded_records = []

        for combo, grp in subset.groupby("combo"):
            mean_cont = float(np.mean(np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - np.abs(grp["auNGA_ratio"] - 1.0)) * 100.0))
            mean_acc = float(np.mean(np.clip(1.0 - (grp["Mismatches per 100kbp"] + grp["Indels per 100kbp"]) / 10.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 100.0))
            clean_pct = float(np.mean(grp["contamination_count"] == 0) * 100.0)
            t_hits = int(grp["contamination_count"].sum())
            t_miss = int(grp["total_missed"].sum())
            score_rep = float(max(0.0, 1.0 - t_miss / 3.0) * 100.0)

            overall_score = (w_acc * mean_acc + w_cont * mean_cont + w_res * clean_pct + w_rep * score_rep)

            is_eligible = True
            reasons = []

            if gate_complete and t_miss > 0:
                is_eligible = False
                reasons.append("fails complete-recovery gate (<95% coverage on at least one replicon)")

            if gate_zero_hits and t_hits > 0:
                is_eligible = False
                reasons.append(f"fails zero-residual-hits gate ({t_hits} hit(s) detected)")

            item = {
                "combo": combo,
                "overall_score": overall_score,
                "display_score": round(overall_score, 1),
                "contiguity": round(mean_cont, 1),
                "accuracy": round(mean_acc, 1),
                "residual": round(clean_pct, 1),
                "replicon": round(score_rep, 1),
                "reasons": reasons
            }

            if is_eligible:
                eligible_records.append(item)
            else:
                excluded_records.append(item)

        # Sort eligible by full precision overall_score descending, then combo
        eligible_records.sort(key=lambda r: (-r["overall_score"], r["combo"]))

        # Competition ranking
        for idx, rec in enumerate(eligible_records):
            if idx == 0:
                rec["rank"] = 1
            else:
                prev = eligible_records[idx - 1]
                if abs(rec["overall_score"] - prev["overall_score"]) < 1e-9:
                    rec["rank"] = prev["rank"]
                else:
                    rec["rank"] = idx + 1

        return eligible_records, excluded_records

    @output
    @render.data_frame
    def ranking_table():
        eligible, _ = evaluated_results()
        if not eligible:
            return pd.DataFrame(columns=["Rank", "Combination", "Preference Score", "Contiguity", "Accuracy", "Residual Removal", "Replicon Recovery"])

        display_rows = []
        for r in eligible:
            display_rows.append({
                "Rank": r["rank"],
                "Combination": r["combo"],
                "Preference Score": r["display_score"],
                "Contiguity": r["contiguity"],
                "Accuracy": r["accuracy"],
                "Residual Removal": r["residual"],
                "Replicon Recovery": r["replicon"]
            })

        res_df = pd.DataFrame(display_rows)
        limit = len(res_df) if show_all.get() else 5
        return res_df.head(limit)

    @output
    @render.ui
    def excluded_combinations_ui():
        _, excluded = evaluated_results()
        n = len(excluded)
        if n == 0:
            return ui.HTML("<details><summary style='cursor: pointer; font-weight: 500;'>Excluded / Ineligible Combinations (0)</summary><p style='margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #64748b;'>All evaluated combinations are currently eligible under active criteria.</p></details>")

        items = []
        for r in excluded:
            reason_txt = "; ".join(r["reasons"])
            items.append(f"<li><strong>{r['combo']}</strong>: {reason_txt}</li>")
        list_html = "".join(items)
        return ui.HTML(f"<details><summary style='cursor: pointer; font-weight: 500; color: #dc2626;'>Excluded / Ineligible Combinations ({n})</summary><ul style='margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.9rem;'>{list_html}</ul></details>")

    @output
    @render.ui
    def selected_combo_detail():
        return ui.HTML("<div class='text-muted' style='font-size: 0.95rem; font-style: italic;'>Select a combination from the shortlist above to inspect per-isolate evidence, warnings, and diagnostic breakdowns.</div>")

app = App(app_ui, server)
```
